answer: A new key cannot mint a chorus of votes with cheap parallelism. Each applicant must finish a verifiable delay function of repeated modular squarings bound to the epoch seed, so tickets are sequential rather than farmable across a thousand cores at once. Completed tickets check in at the intake wharf, and only a published quota of new seats is admitted. Surplus deposits stay frozen until the reward curve hits its nadir two epochs later. Tickets that share a funding UTXO or voucher collapse to one seat, and the velvet rope on residual stake is burned so the farm cannot recycle that slash.
